context: Real Chrome browser, 390x844, local Next 14 development server, public data snapshots. Load event + 8 seconds. No network/CPU throttling or forced garbage collection. Browser extensions enabled. These are local observations, not Preview/Production benchmarks.
limits: Resource Timing transfer sizes can be zero for cached/cross-origin responses. Not all external bytes are observable.
imgInitiatedRequests counts initiatorType=img only, includes local icons and excludes images initiated by preload links or CSS.
JS figures include development/HMR code; dynamic Mapbox adds a script request and did not demonstrate a lower total JS transfer.
The two after observations show image request and resource transfer variation. No guaranteed first-screen request reduction is claimed.
Heap observations are GC- and extension-dependent. FCP/LCP are unthrottled local samples, not a controlled production speedup.
No physical mobile touch or complete Spot route acceptance was performed. Gallery fixture checks were functional only and are excluded from these metrics.
A transient map loading status was added after the final sample; steady-state DOM and payload conclusions are unaffected, but its paint timing is not remeasured.
